# Phil Kruse — Orlando Lakefront & Luxury Real Estate

> Phil Kruse is an Orlando-based lakefront and luxury real estate specialist serving the Conway, Winter Park, and Butler Chain of Lakes since 2001. A portion of every real estate commission is donated to charity, including his ongoing volunteer work with New Image Youth Center.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/): Overview of Phil Kruse's Orlando lakefront and luxury real estate services.
- [About](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/about): Phil's background as an Orlando resident since 2001 and his commitment to giving back.
- [Lakefront Specialty](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/lakefront-specialty): Buying and selling on Orlando's lake chains — shoreline, docks, water rights, and the lakefront market.
- [Charity](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/charities): A portion of every commission goes to the client's chosen charity or New Image Youth Center.
- [Blog](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/blog): Orlando lifestyle, local guides, market news, and real estate insights.
- [Contact](https://www.iamphilkruse.com/contact): Get in touch about buying or selling.
